risks.title: Elevated credit risk
risks.score_rationale: Credit loss provisioning tripled between 2024 and 2025 (25M to 56M), with explicit mention that material adjustments to the provision could harm results. Language emphasizes uncertainty regarding adequacy of existing provision.

risks.title: Sensitivity of provision to economic forecasts
risks.score_rationale: The company uses 24-month macro-economic forecasts and mentions that a scenario reverting to historical loss rates could increase the provision by 89M. This demonstrates strong dependence on economic assumptions.

risks.title: Risk related to CECL methodology
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly mentions a day 1 CECL charge of 20.7M in 2025, indicating a recent major transition or adjustment. This reflects regulatory risk related to CECL standard implementation.

risks.title: Dependence on regional economic conditions
risks.score_rationale: Business is concentrated in Pennsylvania, New York, Ohio and Indiana. The text links lending and deposit collection activities to regional economic conditions, creating geographic concentration risk.

risks.title: Ongoing litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions ongoing proceedings but asserts that their resolution would have no material effect according to management. Language is reassuring, but risk exists.

risks.title: Operational risk related to physical infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: The company operates 161 branches and 140M USD in net fixed asset value. While not explicitly presented as a major risk, the size of the network implies operational risks related to maintenance, security and modernization.

ai_positioning.summary: NWBI does not have significant mentions concerning artificial intelligence, machine learning or similar technologies in the provided extracts from its 10-K/20-F document.
